channel.title: Daily Applied Wisdom
channel.description: One book. Three ideas. Better thinking.

item.title: The Psychology of Money
item.description: Build a financial life you can actually sustain by respecting personal context, leaving room for error and deciding what enough means before risk decides for you.

item.title: Software Engineering at Google
item.description: How to keep software changeable, understandable and economically sustainable as years, teams and dependencies accumulate.

item.title: Thinking in Systems
item.description: A compact language for seeing the structures beneath recurring events and finding interventions with more leverage than another local fix.

item.title: The Design of Everyday Things
item.description: When users repeatedly make the same mistake, the interface may be teaching the wrong action.

item.title: The Goal
item.description: Improve the whole system by finding what actually limits it, managing flow instead of busyness and judging changes by global outcomes.

item.title: Team Topologies
item.description: Treat team boundaries and interaction patterns as part of the software-delivery system, constrained by finite cognitive capacity.

item.title: Superforecasting
item.description: Make uncertain decisions more honest by starting with base rates, updating explicit probabilities as evidence changes and keeping score long enough to learn.

item.title: Working Effectively with Legacy Code
item.description: Change risky code in controlled steps by building feedback around real behaviour, finding seams that isolate dependencies and sprouting new tested code beside the old.
